questlog.editor.title: Questlog Editor
questlog.menu.delete.confirm.title: Confirm Deletion
questlog.menu.delete.confirm.message: Are you sure you want to delete '%s'?
questlog.menu.delete_chapter.confirm.mes: Are you sure you want to delete chapter '%s'? Quests inside will be moved to the main chapter.
questlog.editor.tooltip.id: Generated from the chapter and title, with a unique number allocated on first save. Remains stable after creation.
questlog.editor.tooltip.title: Quest title. New titles are limited to 50 characters; longer existing titles are preserved and shown on at most two lines.
questlog.editor.tooltip.description: Required description. Write it before activating the quest.
questlog.editor.tooltip.icon: The ID of the item to display as the quest's icon (e.g., minecraft:diamond_sword).
questlog.editor.tooltip.chapter: The chapter ID this quest belongs to.
questlog.editor.tooltip.order: The sorting index. Quests with lower values appear first.
questlog.editor.tooltip.hidden: If enabled, this quest will be hidden from the questlog entirely.
questlog.editor.tooltip.hide_when_comple: If enabled, this quest is removed from the log once every objective is completed and all rewards have been collected.
questlog.editor.tooltip.include_in_main: If enabled, the quest will be shown in the main chapter list in addition to its assigned chapter.
questlog.editor.tooltip.details_default: If enabled and additional details exist, opening this quest shows its Details page first. Back returns to the quest overview.
questlog.editor.tooltip.details_disabled: Hides the Details button. Objectives and rewards remain visible in the quest overview.
questlog.editor.tooltip.reward_preview: Default uses the client config. Show or Hide overrides it for this quest.
questlog.editor.tooltip.repeatable: If enabled, this quest can be reset and recompleted infinitely after completion.
questlog.editor.tooltip.global: If enabled, completing this quest will complete it for all players on the server.
questlog.editor.tooltip.entry_name: A custom display name for this specific objective or reward (optional).
questlog.editor.tooltip.entry_icon: An optional custom icon for this specific objective or reward (item ID, texture path, or icon object).
questlog.editor.tooltip.entry_target: The target registry key, tag, or value for this entry (e.g., minecraft:stone).
questlog.editor.tooltip.entry_target.bou: Target block position (x, y, z) or bounding volume (minX, minY, minZ, maxX, maxY, maxZ).
questlog.editor.tooltip.entry_amount: The required count, amount, or experience points.
questlog.editor.tooltip.entry_range: The radius (in blocks) the player must be within to trigger the approach.
questlog.editor.tooltip.entry_slot: The equipment slot to check: mainhand, offhand, head, chest, legs, feet. Leave blank for any slot.
questlog.editor.tooltip.levels: If enabled, the reward/objective value specifies levels instead of experience points.
questlog.editor.tooltip.advanced.transla: If enabled, the title, description, and other text fields are treated as translation keys instead of literal text.
questlog.editor.tooltip.advanced.toast_o: If enabled, a toast notification is shown when this quest is unlocked.
If enabled, a toast notification is shown when this quest is completed.
questlog.editor.tooltip.advanced.show_po: If enabled, a popup is shown in the center of the screen when this quest is unlocked.
questlog.editor.tooltip.advanced.panel_s: The pixel size of the quest panel background. Only takes effect with a matching custom texture.
questlog.editor.tooltip.advanced.panel_o: Shifts this panel's contents by this many pixels.
questlog.editor.tooltip.advanced.backgro: The texture used for the left panel's background (e.g., questlog:textures/gui/quest_page.png).
questlog.editor.tooltip.advanced.right_p: The texture for the right-hand panel. Leave blank to use the background texture.
questlog.editor.tooltip.advanced.periphe: The texture used for shared UI elements like tabs and buttons.
questlog.editor.tooltip.advanced.overlay: An optional texture drawn over the quest panel (e.g., for custom decorations).
Leave blank to match the panel's own size.
questlog.editor.tooltip.advanced.sound: A sound event ID to play (e.g., minecraft:entity.player.levelup). Leave blank for none.
questlog.editor.tooltip.advanced.color: A hex color code (e.g., FFFFFF). Leave blank to use the default.
questlog.editor.tooltip.advanced.button_: Overrides the default label text. Leave blank to use the default.
questlog.editor.tooltip.advanced.descrip: Overrides the description shown when the quest is in this state. Leave blank to always use the main description.
questlog.editor.tooltip.chapter_id: The unique ID used to identify this chapter (e.g., questlog:my_chapter).
questlog.editor.tooltip.chapter_title: The display name of the chapter tab.
questlog.editor.tooltip.chapter_icon: The ID of the item to display as the chapter tab's icon (e.g., minecraft:book).
questlog.editor.tooltip.chapter_order: The sorting index. Chapters with lower values appear first on the tabs.
questlog.editor.tooltip.chapter_default: If enabled, this chapter tab will be selected by default when the questlog is opened.
questlog.editor.tooltip.chapter_hidden: If enabled, this chapter tab will be hidden from the questlog.
questlog.editor.tooltip.delete_entry: Delete this entry from the list.
